name: Tea
description: A beverage made from the leaves of Camellia sinensis, cultivated and consumed in East Asia before spreading across Asia and eventually becoming a global commodity.

places.name: China
places.notes: Tea has a long history of cultivation and consumption in China, where traditions of tea drinking developed over many centuries.

places.name: Japan
places.notes: Tea was introduced to Japan from China, with Buddhist monks playing an important role in its early transmission.

places.name: Korea
places.notes: Tea cultivation and consumption reached Korea through cultural and religious connections with China.

places.name: India
places.notes: Large-scale commercial tea cultivation developed in India during the British colonial period.

places.name: Sri Lanka
places.notes: Commercial tea cultivation expanded rapidly in Sri Lanka during the nineteenth century.

places.name: United Kingdom
places.notes: Tea became increasingly popular in Britain after being introduced through international trade, eventually becoming an important part of British culture.
